seoTitle: Master of Flags: Flag Quiz on a 3D Globe, Free and No Ads
metaDescription: Learn every flag on Earth on a 3D globe you paint with each flag you get right. 250 country cards, 33 expeditions and a Daily Challenge. Free, no ads.
heroHeadline: Paint the world with every flag you learn
heroSubhead: Master of Flags 5.0 is a flag and capitals quiz played on a 3D globe that becomes yours: every country you get right is painted with its flag. No ads, no subscription, no account. Free on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch.
highlights: The Atlas: a 3D globe painted with every flag you get right
250 country cards with 1,000 stamps, from Bronze to holographic
33 expeditions with three stars each, and Explorer ranks up to Grand Master of Flags
No ads, no subscription, no account; Pro is one optional purchase

features.title: The Atlas
features.body: Your globe is the game: answer on it, turn it and zoom it, and watch each flag fly to its country and paint it. Everything you learned before 5.0 is painted onto your globe the first time you open it.

features.title: Find it on the globe
features.body: A new kind of question asks you to tap a country you have already discovered, so you learn where every flag lives, not only what it looks like.

features.title: Wrong answers teach
features.body: Miss a flag and you see the right one, its capital and what to look for. Flags and capitals across Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, Oceania and the whole world, all free.

features.title: 250 cards to collect
features.body: Every country is a card with four stamps to earn, Flag, Name, Capital and Place, from Bronze to holographic. The back of every card is the encyclopedia: the story behind the flag, what its colors and symbols mean, the country shape, neighbors, languages, currencies and a short history.

features.title: Expeditions and ranks
features.body: 33 expeditions with one to three stars each, from Nordic Crosses and Tricolour Trouble to The Silk Road and Island Hopper, and Explorer ranks from Cadet to Grand Master of Flags.

features.title: A Daily Challenge with a fair streak
features.body: The same ten flags for everyone, once a day, with a result you can share as a picture. Streak freezes cover a skipped day and a 48-hour repair window forgives a broken run.

features.title: Every Apple screen
features.body: The Atlas on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, Couch Mode on Apple TV for two to four players with one remote, Flash questions and your Daily streak on Apple Watch, a Mac app, and widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen.

features.title: Pro: drill what you miss
features.body: Every expedition, four Looks for your globe (Paper, Blueprint, Aurora and Gold), a poster of your world to keep and share, Smart Review, Similar Flags, Hard Mode, full statistics, the Daily Archive and five streak freezes a month.

pricing.heading: Free to play. Pro is one purchase.

faq.q: Is Master of Flags really free?
faq.a: Yes. The globe, all 250 countries, every question, stamps and cards, both quiz modes, all six regions, the Daily Challenge, streaks and Game Center are free, with no ads and no account. Pro is optional.

faq.q: What is new in Master of Flags 5.0?
faq.a: The game now happens on a globe that becomes yours. Every country you get right is painted with its flag, and each flag flies to its country as you answer. There is a new question that asks you to find a country on the globe, 250 country cards to collect with four stamps each, 33 expeditions with stars to earn, Explorer ranks from Cadet to Grand Master of Flags, and the Daily, Smart Review and Similar Flags are played on the globe too.

faq.q: Do I lose my progress in 5.0?
faq.a: No. The first time you open 5.0, everything you already knew is painted onto your globe, your lifetime points become your Explorer rank, and your Daily streak, freezes, results, bookmarks, region levels, Game Center scores and Pro stay exactly as they were.

faq.q: What does Pro unlock, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Pro is a one-time $6.99 purchase. From 5.0 it adds every expedition (the first chapter is free), four Looks for your globe and a poster of your world, on top of Hard Mode, Smart Review, Similar Flags, full statistics, replay of any Daily Challenge you missed and five streak freezes a month instead of one. If you already own Pro, all of it is yours. There is no subscription.

faq.q: Do I pay again on another device, or for my family?
faq.a: No. Pro is a Universal Purchase across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, and Family Sharing lets your family use it too. If it does not appear on a device, tap Restore Purchases.

faq.q: I bought the app years ago when it was paid. Do I pay again?
faq.a: No. Everyone who bought it during the paid era gets Pro automatically, free, forever. It unlocks by itself the first time you open the app on each device; if it does not, tap Restore Purchases.

No accounts, analytics, ads or tracking. The app holds an anonymous Midgar ID, and a Pro purchase or restore is recorded under it so it can be restored. Your progress, streak and bookmarks can follow you across your devices through your own iCloud account. The flags and the whole encyclopedia are bundled with the app and work offline.

faq.q: Which devices and languages are supported?
faq.a: iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later, Mac with macOS 26 or later, Apple TV with tvOS 18 or later and Apple Watch with watchOS 11 or later. The app is translated into English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Norwegian and Swedish.
